content.json: # Azure AI estate v2

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| where properties.state =~ 'Enabled'
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Subscriptions to scan for AI resources.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
   or type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| summarize Items = count() by resourceGroup
| project value = resourceGroup, label = strcat(resourceGroup, ' (', Items, ')'), selected = false
| order by label asc

parameters.name: ModelAccounts
parameters.label: Model account
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| where kind in~ ('OpenAI','AIServices')
| extend kindRank = iff(kind =~ 'OpenAI', 0, 1)
| order by kindRank asc, name asc
| extend rn = row_number()
| project value = id, label = strcat(name, '  [', kind, ']'), selected = (rn == 1)
parameters.description: Account whose model deployments are listed. Set by clicking a row in the account grid on the Model deployments tab.

parameters.name: AccountRegion
parameters.label: Account region
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccounts}')
| project value = location, label = location, selected = true
parameters.description: Region of the selected model account, used to read the matching model catalog.

parameters.name: AccountSubscription
parameters.label: Account subscription
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where tolower(id) == tolower('{ModelAccounts}')
| project value = subscriptionId, label = subscriptionId, selected = true
parameters.description: Subscription of the selected model account.

parameters.name: AccountSubscriptionName
parameters.label: Account subscription name

    resourcecontainers

  ) on subscriptionId

parameters.description: Display name of the selected model account subscription.

parameters.name: AccountResourceGroup
parameters.label: Account resource group
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'

parameters.name: AccountKind

content.json: ## Issue overview

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend acctKind   = tostring(kind)
| extend isModelHost = (acctKind in~ ('OpenAI','AIServices'))
| extend skuName    = tostring(sku.name)
| extend identityType = tostring(identity.type)
| extend pna        = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)
| extend localAuthDisabled = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth)
| extend subdomain  = tostring(properties.customSubDomainName)
| extend restrictOutbound = tobool(properties.restrictOutboundNetworkAccess)
| extend netDefault = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction)
| extend ipRuleCount = toint(array_length(todynamic(properties.networkAcls.ipRules)))
| extend vnetRuleCount = toint(array_length(todynamic(properties.networkAcls.virtualNetworkRules)))
| extend cmkSource  = tostring(properties.encryption.keySource)
| extend allowProjectMgmt = tobool(properties.allowProjectManagement)
| extend state      = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| extend created    = todatetime(properties.dateCreated)
| extend endpoint   = tostring(properties.endpoint)
| extend isMigrated = tobool(properties.isMigrated)
| extend peCount    = toint(array_length(todynamic(properties.privateEndpointConnections)))
| extend KindLabel  = case(
      acctKind =~ 'OpenAI',     'Azure OpenAI',
      acctKind =~ 'AIServices', 'Microsoft Foundry (AI Services)',
      acctKind =~ 'CognitiveServices', 'Cognitive Services (multi-service)',
      acctKind)
| extend IssueList = array_concat(
    iff(localAuthDisabled != true,                      pack_array('API key (local) auth enabled - prefer Entra ID'), dynamic([])),
    iff(pna =~ 'Enabled' and peCount == 0,              pack_array('Public network access with no private endpoint'), dynamic([])),
    iff(pna =~ 'Enabled' and netDefault !~ 'Deny',      pack_array('Network ACLs allow all traffic'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(identityType) or identityType =~ 'None', pack_array('No managed identity'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isModelHost and isempty(subdomain),             pack_array('No custom subdomain - Entra ID auth unavailable'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(cmkSource) or cmkSource =~ 'Microsoft.CognitiveServices', pack_array('Microsoft-managed keys (no CMK)'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isModelHost and restrictOutbound != true,       pack_array('Outbound network access unrestricted'), dynamic([])),
    iff(state !~ 'Succeeded',                           pack_array(strcat('Provisioning state: ', state)), dynamic([]))
  )
| extend IssueCount = array_length(IssueList)
| extend Issues     = strcat_array(IssueList, ' | ')
| extend Severity = case(
      IssueCount >= 6, 'Critical',
      IssueCount >= 4, 'High',
      IssueCount >= 2, 'Medium',
      IssueCount >= 1, 'Low',
                       'Healthy')
| extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == 'Critical', 0, Severity == 'High', 1, Severity == 'Medium', 2, Severity == 'Low', 3, 4)
| summarize
    ModelHosts  = countif(isModelHost),
    OpenAIAcct  = countif(acctKind =~ 'OpenAI'),
    FoundryAcct = countif(acctKind =~ 'AIServices'),
    OtherAI     = countif(isModelHost == false),
    AtRisk      = countif(IssueCount > 0),
    CritHigh    = countif(Severity in ('Critical','High')),
    KeyAuth     = countif(localAuthDisabled != true),
    OpenNet     = countif(pna =~ 'Enabled' and peCount == 0)
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Model-hosting accounts',   'Value', ModelHosts,  'Rank', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'Azure OpenAI',             'Value', OpenAIAcct,  'Rank', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'Microsoft Foundry',        'Value', FoundryAcct, 'Rank', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Other AI services',        'Value', OtherAI,     'Rank', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Accounts with findings',   'Value', AtRisk,      'Rank', 5),
    pack('Metric', 'Critical or high',         'Value', CritHigh,    'Rank', 6),
    pack('Metric', 'API key auth enabled',     'Value', KeyAuth,     'Rank', 7),
    pack('Metric', 'Public, no private endpoint', 'Value', OpenNet,  'Rank', 8))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tiles.Metric), Value = toint(Tiles.Value), Rank = toint(Tiles.Rank)
| order by Rank asc

content.json: ## AI security posture

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
   or type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| extend
    ResourceKind = case(
        type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces', 'ML workspace',
        kind =~ 'OpenAI', 'Azure OpenAI',
        kind =~ 'AIServices', 'Microsoft Foundry',
        'Other AI service'),
    IdentityType = tostring(identity.type),
    LocalAuthDisabled = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth),
    Pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
    NetDefault = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction),
    PeCount = toint(array_length(todynamic(properties.privateEndpointConnections))),
    RestrictOutbound = tobool(properties.restrictOutboundNetworkAccess),
    Isolation = tostring(properties.managedNetwork.isolationMode),
    KeyVaultUri = coalesce(
        tostring(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties.keyVaultUri),
        tostring(properties.keyVault))
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    NoIdentity = countif(isempty(IdentityType) or IdentityType =~ 'None'),
    KeyAuth = countif(LocalAuthDisabled != true),
    PublicOpen = countif(Pna =~ 'Enabled' and PeCount == 0),
    WithPrivateEndpoint = countif(PeCount > 0),
    AclAllowAll = countif(isempty(NetDefault) or NetDefault =~ 'Allow'),
    EgressOpen = countif(RestrictOutbound != true and isempty(Isolation)),
    NoKeyVault = countif(isempty(KeyVaultUri))
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'AI resources in scope',      'Value', Total,               'Rank', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'No managed identity',         'Value', NoIdentity,          'Rank', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'API key auth enabled',        'Value', KeyAuth,             'Rank', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Public, no private endpoint', 'Value', PublicOpen,          'Rank', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Private endpoint configured', 'Value', WithPrivateEndpoint, 'Rank', 5),
    pack('Metric', 'Network ACLs allow all',      'Value', AclAllowAll,         'Rank', 6),
    pack('Metric', 'Egress unrestricted',         'Value', EgressOpen,          'Rank', 7),
    pack('Metric', 'No Key Vault or CMK',         'Value', NoKeyVault,          'Rank', 8))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tiles.Metric), Value = toint(Tiles.Value), Rank = toint(Tiles.Rank)
| order by Rank asc
content.title: Security posture summary

content.json: ### Identity, API keys, and Key Vault

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
   or type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend
    ResourceKind = case(
        type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces', 'ML workspace',
        kind =~ 'OpenAI', 'Azure OpenAI',
        kind =~ 'AIServices', 'Microsoft Foundry',
        'Other AI service'),
    IdentityType = tostring(identity.type),
    UserAssignedCount = toint(array_length(todynamic(identity.userAssignedIdentities))),
    PrincipalId = tostring(identity.principalId),
    LocalAuthDisabled = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth),
    Subdomain = tostring(properties.customSubDomainName),
    CmkSource = tostring(properties.encryption.keySource),
    KeyVaultUri = coalesce(
        tostring(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties.keyVaultUri),
        tostring(properties.keyVault))
| extend Findings = array_concat(
    iff(isempty(IdentityType) or IdentityType =~ 'None', pack_array('No managed identity'), dynamic([])),
    iff(LocalAuthDisabled != true, pack_array('API keys enabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(KeyVaultUri), pack_array('No Key Vault or customer-managed key'), dynamic([])),
    iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and isempty(Subdomain), pack_array('No custom subdomain - Entra ID auth unavailable'), dynamic([])))
| extend RiskRank = case(
    array_length(Findings) >= 3, 0,
    array_length(Findings) == 2, 1,
    array_length(Findings) == 1, 2,
    3)
| project
    Resource = name,
    Subscription,
    ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup,
    Risk = case(RiskRank == 0, 'Critical', RiskRank == 1, 'High', RiskRank == 2, 'Medium', 'Healthy'),
    Type = ResourceKind,
    Region = location,
    ['Managed identity'] = iff(isempty(IdentityType) or IdentityType =~ 'None', 'None', IdentityType),
    ['User-assigned count'] = coalesce(UserAssignedCount, 0),
    ['Identity principal ID'] = iff(isempty(PrincipalId), '-', PrincipalId),
    ['API key auth'] = case(isnull(LocalAuthDisabled), 'Unknown', LocalAuthDisabled == true, 'Disabled (Entra ID only)', 'Enabled - keys usable'),
    ['Key Vault / CMK'] = iff(isempty(KeyVaultUri), 'Microsoft-managed key', KeyVaultUri),
    ['Encryption source'] = iff(isempty(CmkSource), 'Microsoft-managed', CmkSource),
    ['Custom subdomain'] = iff(isempty(Subdomain), 'Not set', Subdomain),
    Findings = iff(array_length(Findings) == 0, 'No findings', strcat_array(Findings, ' | ')),
    RiskRank,
    ResourceId = id
| order by RiskRank asc, Resource asc
| project-away RiskRank
content.title: Managed identity, API keys, and Key Vault

content.json: ### RBAC on AI resources

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend
    AssignmentScope = tolower(tostring(properties.scope)),
    RoleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId)),
    PrincipalType = tostring(properties.principalType),
    PrincipalId = tostring(properties.principalId),
    CreatedOn = todatetime(properties.createdOn)
| where AssignmentScope has 'cognitiveservices/accounts' or AssignmentScope has 'machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| extend RoleGuid = tostring(split(RoleDefinitionId, '/')[-1])
| extend
    BuiltInName = case(

content.json: ## AI Hub, AI Project and Azure ML workspaces

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend wsKind   = tostring(kind)
| extend hubId    = tostring(properties.hubResourceId)
| extend pna      = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)
| extend isolation = tostring(properties.managedNetwork.isolationMode)
| extend authMode = tostring(properties.systemDatastoresAuthMode)
| extend cmkEnabled = tobool(properties.enableServiceSideCMKEncryption)
| extend hbi      = tobool(properties.hbiWorkspace)
| extend softDelete = tobool(properties.softDeleteEnabled)
| extend privateLinks = toint(properties.privateLinkCount)
| extend v1Legacy = tobool(properties.v1LegacyMode)
| extend dataIsolation = tobool(properties.enableDataIsolation)
| extend identityType = tostring(identity.type)
| extend state    = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| extend friendly = tostring(properties.friendlyName)
| extend created  = todatetime(properties.creationTime)
| extend storageId = tostring(properties.storageAccount)
| extend kvId     = tostring(properties.keyVault)
| extend KindLabel = case(
      wsKind =~ 'Hub',     'AI Hub',
      wsKind =~ 'Project', 'AI Project',
      wsKind =~ 'Default', 'Azure ML workspace',
      wsKind =~ 'FeatureStore', 'Feature store',
      iff(isempty(wsKind), 'Azure ML workspace', wsKind))
| extend IssueList = array_concat(
    iff(pna =~ 'Enabled' and privateLinks == 0,   pack_array('Public network access with no private link'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isolation =~ 'Disabled',                  pack_array('Managed VNet isolation disabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(authMode =~ 'accesskey',                  pack_array('Datastores use access keys - prefer identity'), dynamic([])),
    iff(cmkEnabled != true,                       pack_array('No customer-managed key encryption'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(identityType) or identityType =~ 'None', pack_array('No managed identity'), dynamic([])),
    iff(softDelete != true,                       pack_array('Soft delete not enabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(v1Legacy == true,                         pack_array('v1 legacy mode enabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(wsKind =~ 'Project' and isempty(hubId),   pack_array('Project not linked to a hub'), dynamic([])),
    iff(state !~ 'Succeeded',                     pack_array(strcat('Provisioning state: ', state)), dynamic([]))
  )
| extend IssueCount = array_length(IssueList)
| extend Issues     = strcat_array(IssueList, ' | ')
| extend Severity = case(
      IssueCount >= 6, 'Critical',
      IssueCount >= 4, 'High',
      IssueCount >= 2, 'Medium',
      IssueCount >= 1, 'Low',
                       'Healthy')
| extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == 'Critical', 0, Severity == 'High', 1, Severity == 'Medium', 2, Severity == 'Low', 3, 4)
| summarize
    Hubs = countif(wsKind =~ 'Hub'),
    Projects = countif(wsKind =~ 'Project'),
    Other = countif(wsKind !~ 'Hub' and wsKind !~ 'Project'),
    AtRisk = countif(IssueCount > 0),
    NoIsolation = countif(isolation =~ 'Disabled'),
    KeyDatastores = countif(authMode =~ 'accesskey')
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'AI Hubs',                  'Value', Hubs,          'Rank', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'AI Projects',              'Value', Projects,      'Rank', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'Other ML workspaces',      'Value', Other,         'Rank', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Workspaces with findings', 'Value', AtRisk,        'Rank', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Managed VNet disabled',    'Value', NoIsolation,   'Rank', 5),
    pack('Metric', 'Datastores using keys',    'Value', KeyDatastores, 'Rank', 6))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tiles.Metric), Value = toint(Tiles.Value), Rank = toint(Tiles.Rank)
| order by Rank asc

content.json:
## About the data in this workbook

This workbook mixes two data sources on purpose, because neither one alone can
cover an Azure AI estate.

### What Azure Resource Graph can and cannot see

Measured against live fixtures, not assumed from ARM template documentation:

| Resource type | Indexed in Resource Graph? |
| --- | --- |
| `microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts` | **Yes** - fully, and verified to match the ARM control plane exactly |
| `microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/projects` (Foundry projects) | **Yes** |
| `microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces` (Hub / Project / ML) | **Yes** - rich properties |
| `microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/deployments` (**model deployments**) | **No - zero rows. Not indexed at all.** |

For accounts, each of `identity.type`, `disableLocalAuth`, `publicNetworkAccess`,
`restrictOutboundNetworkAccess`, `networkAcls.defaultAction`, `networkAcls.ipRules`,
`allowProjectManagement` and `customSubDomainName` was **set through ARM and then
re-read in Resource Graph** to confirm it round-trips. A blank value therefore means
*not configured*, never *not indexed*.

### How model data is retrieved

Because model deployments are invisible to Resource Graph:

1. A Resource Graph query lists every in-scope Azure OpenAI / Foundry account.
2. The Model deployments tab reads the selected account's ARM `/deployments`
   endpoint directly, with one grid row per returned deployment.
3. The Model retirement tab reads the regional model catalog
   (`.../locations/{region}/models`) for live retirement dates and lifecycle status.

The deployments grid is deliberately not merged with the catalog: Workbooks exposes
only one join-column pair, and a composite JSONPath key can evaluate empty in some
portal runtimes, turning the merge into a deployment-by-catalog cross join.
Retirement dates are never hard-coded - they come from the catalog at query time.

### How service retirement data is retrieved

The **Service retirements** tab keeps Service Health and Advisor as independent
sources:

1. `ServiceHealthResources` from Azure Resource Graph for subscription-specific
   Health Advisory retirement events retained by Azure, including elapsed deadlines.
2. `providers/Microsoft.Advisor/metadata` from the ARM control plane for Microsoft's
   published Service Upgrade and Retirement metadata catalog from 2024 onward,
   including elapsed and future dates.

The Service Health grid is filtered to AI-related retirement titles and summaries.
The Advisor summary covers AI, Data, Network, and Infrastructure metadata. Within
the Advisor section only, direct recommendation IDs are left-joined to resource
counts from `advisorresources`; row selection filters a separate affected-resources
grid below. Advisor metadata is a global planning catalog and does not by itself
prove that a service is deployed in the selected scope.

### Findings

**Accounts** - API key auth enabled instead of Entra ID only; public network access
with no private endpoint; network ACLs allowing all traffic; no managed identity;
no custom subdomain (which blocks Entra ID auth); Microsoft-managed keys instead of
CMK; unrestricted outbound access; failed provisioning.

**Workspaces** - public access with no private link; managed VNet isolation disabled;
datastores using access keys instead of identity; no CMK; no managed identity; soft
delete off; v1 legacy mode; project not linked to a hub; failed provisioning.

| Severity | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| Critical | 6 or more findings |
| High | 4-5 findings |
| Medium | 2-3 findings |
| Low | 1 finding |
| Healthy | No findings |

resourcecontainers
| take 1
| project items=dynamic([{FleetDeploymentPayloads}])
| extend chunks=range(0, tolong(array_length(items)/2000), 1)
| mv-expand chunk=chunks limit 2000
| extend batch=array_slice(items, toint(chunk)*2000, toint(chunk)*2000+1999)
| mv-expand d=batch limit 2000
| project d
| extend deploymentId=tolower(substring(tostring(d.deploymentId),2))
| where isnotempty(deploymentId)
| summarize by deploymentId
| order by deploymentId asc
| extend rowIndex=row_number()
| where (rowIndex-1) % 1000 == 0
| project V2PageIndex=toint((rowIndex-1)/1000)
| summarize pages=make_set(V2PageIndex)

| mv-expand page=pages limit 2000
| project V2PageIndex=toint(page)
| order by V2PageIndex asc

// V2_RETIREMENT_REPORT
resourcecontainers
| take 1
| project items=dynamic([{FleetDeploymentPayloads}])
| extend chunks=range(0, tolong(array_length(items)/2000), 1)
| mv-expand chunk=chunks limit 2000
| extend batch=array_slice(items, toint(chunk)*2000, toint(chunk)*2000+1999)
| mv-expand d=batch limit 2000
| project d
| extend d=pack('deploymentId', substring(tostring(d.deploymentId),2), 'deploymentName', substring(tostring(d.deploymentName),2),
    'hostId', substring(tostring(d.hostId),2), 'modelName', substring(tostring(d.modelName),2), 'modelVersion', substring(tostring(d.modelVersion),2),
    'modelFormat', substring(tostring(d.modelFormat),2), 'deploymentSku', substring(tostring(d.deploymentSku),2),
    'capacity', substring(tostring(d.capacity),2), 'upgradePolicy', substring(tostring(d.upgradePolicy),2),
    'provisioningState', substring(tostring(d.provisioningState),2), 'runId', substring(tostring(d.runId),2))
| extend deploymentId=tolower(tostring(d.deploymentId)), hostId=tolower(tostring(d.hostId))
| where isnotempty(deploymentId)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | take 1
    | project items=dynamic([{FleetCatalogPayloads}])
    | extend chunks=range(0, tolong(array_length(items)/2000), 1)
| mv-expand chunk=chunks limit 2000
| extend batch=array_slice(items, toint(chunk)*2000, toint(chunk)*2000+1999)
| mv-expand c=batch limit 2000
| project c
    | extend c=pack('deploymentId', substring(tostring(c.deploymentId),2), 'hostId', substring(tostring(c.hostId),2),
        'region', substring(tostring(c.region),2), 'subscriptionId', substring(tostring(c.subscriptionId),2),
        'accountKind', substring(tostring(c.accountKind),2), 'modelName', substring(tostring(c.modelName),2),
        'modelVersion', substring(tostring(c.modelVersion),2), 'modelFormat', substring(tostring(c.modelFormat),2),
        'lifecycle', substring(tostring(c.lifecycle),2), 'inferenceDate', substring(tostring(c.inferenceDate),2),
        'fineTuneDate', substring(tostring(c.fineTuneDate),2), 'skuMatchesJson', tostring(c.skuMatchesJson),
        'runId', substring(tostring(c.runId),2))
    | project deploymentId=tolower(tostring(c.deploymentId)), c
) on deploymentId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | take 1
    | project items=dynamic([{FleetAccountPayloads}])
    | extend chunks=range(0, tolong(array_length(items)/2000), 1)
| mv-expand chunk=chunks limit 2000
| extend batch=array_slice(items, toint(chunk)*2000, toint(chunk)*2000+1999)
| mv-expand a=batch limit 2000
| project a
    | extend a=pack('hostId', substring(tostring(a.hostId),2), 'accountName', substring(tostring(a.accountName),2),
        'accountKind', substring(tostring(a.accountKind),2), 'region', substring(tostring(a.region),2),
        'subscriptionId', substring(tostring(a.subscriptionId),2), 'subscriptionName', substring(tostring(a.subscriptionName),2),
        'resourceGroup', substring(tostring(a.resourceGroup),2), 'observedAt', substring(tostring(a.observedAt),2),
        'runId', substring(tostring(a.runId),2))
    | project hostId=tolower(tostring(a.hostId)), a
) on hostId
| extend exactMatch=isnotempty(tostring(d.modelName)) and isnotempty(tostring(d.modelVersion))
    and isnotempty(tostring(d.modelFormat)) and isnotempty(tostring(a.hostId))
    and tostring(d.runId)==tostring(a.runId) and tostring(c.runId)==tostring(a.runId)
    and tostring(c.hostId) =~ tostring(d.hostId)
    and tostring(c.subscriptionId) =~ tostring(a.subscriptionId)
    and tostring(c.region) =~ tostring(a.region)
    and tostring(c.accountKind) == tostring(a.accountKind)
    and tostring(c.modelName) == tostring(d.modelName)
    and tostring(c.modelVersion) == tostring(d.modelVersion)
    and tostring(c.modelFormat) == tostring(d.modelFormat)
| summarize deployments=make_set(d, 2), accounts=make_set(a, 2),
    matches=make_set_if(c, exactMatch, 2),
    staleCatalog=countif(isnotempty(tostring(c.deploymentId)) and tostring(c.runId)!=tostring(a.runId)),
    rejected=countif(isnotempty(tostring(c.deploymentId)) and not(exactMatch))
    by deploymentId
| extend d=deployments[0], a=accounts[0],
    matchCount=array_length(matches),
    m=iff(array_length(matches)==1, matches[0], dynamic({}))
| extend skus=parse_json(tostring(m.skuMatchesJson))
| extend skuCount=coalesce(array_length(skus), 0)
| extend sku=iff(skuCount==1, skus[0], dynamic({}))
| extend modelDate=todatetime(m.inferenceDate),
    fineTuneDate=todatetime(m.fineTuneDate),
    skuDate=todatetime(sku.deprecationDate)
| extend status=case(
    array_length(deployments)!=1, 'Deployment changed during load - reload',
    array_length(accounts)!=1, 'Account metadata missing or ambiguous',
    tostring(d.runId)!=tostring(a.runId), 'Deployment data stale or collection incomplete',
    isempty(tostring(d.modelName)) or isempty(tostring(d.modelVersion)) or isempty(tostring(d.modelFormat)), 'Deployment model identity incomplete',
    matchCount==0 and staleCatalog>0, 'Catalog data stale or collection incomplete',
    matchCount==0 and rejected>0, 'Catalog identity mismatch',
    matchCount==0, 'No exact catalog match',
    matchCount>1, 'Conflicting catalog matches',
    isempty(tostring(d.deploymentSku)), 'Deployment SKU not reported',
    isnull(array_length(skus)), 'Invalid SKU metadata',
    skuCount==0, 'Model matched; SKU not in catalog',
    skuCount>1, 'Ambiguous SKU metadata',
    tostring(sku.name)!=tostring(d.deploymentSku), 'Catalog SKU mismatch',
    (isnotempty(tostring(m.inferenceDate)) and isnull(modelDate))
        or (isnotempty(tostring(sku.deprecationDate)) and isnull(skuDate)), 'Invalid retirement date in API response',
    isnull(modelDate) and isnull(skuDate), 'No retirement date published',
    'Matched')
| extend effectiveDate=iff(status=='Matched', coalesce(skuDate, modelDate), datetime(null)),
    lifecycle=tostring(m.lifecycle)
| extend daysRemaining=datetime_diff('day', startofday(effectiveDate), startofday(now()))
| extend retirementWindow=case(
    isnull(effectiveDate), 'Not assessed / no date',
    daysRemaining<=0, 'Reported date reached or passed',
    daysRemaining<=30, 'Within 30 days',
    daysRemaining<=60, '31-60 days',
    daysRemaining<=90, '61-90 days',
    'More than 90 days'),
    dateBasis=case(isnull(effectiveDate), '', isnotnull(skuDate), 'Deployment SKU', 'Model inference'),
    dateMeaning=case(isnull(effectiveDate), '', lifecycle =~ 'Preview', 'Preview earliest date - may be extended', 'API-reported date - subject to change')
| extend riskRank=case(isnull(effectiveDate), 2, daysRemaining<=90, 0, 1)
| project
    ['Foundry / OpenAI account']=tostring(a.accountName),
    ['Account kind']=tostring(a.accountKind),
    Deployment=tostring(d.deploymentName),
    Model=tostring(d.modelName),
    Version=tostring(d.modelVersion),
    Format=tostring(d.modelFormat),
    SKU=tostring(d.deploymentSku),
    Capacity=todouble(d.capacity),
    ['Retirement date']=effectiveDate,
    ['Days remaining']=daysRemaining,
    ['Retirement window']=retirementWindow,
    ['Metadata status']=status,
    ['Date basis']=dateBasis,
    ['Date interpretation']=dateMeaning,
    ['Model inference retirement']=modelDate,
    ['SKU retirement']=skuDate,
    ['Fine-tuning retirement']=fineTuneDate,
    ['API lifecycle']=lifecycle,
    ['Upgrade policy']=tostring(d.upgradePolicy),
    ['Migration note']=iff(tostring(d.deploymentSku) contains 'Provisioned', 'Provisioned deployments require manual migration', 'Review upgrade policy and current retirement guidance'),
    ['Provisioning state']=tostring(d.provisioningState),
    Subscription=tostring(a.subscriptionName),
    ['Subscription ID']=tostring(a.subscriptionId),
    ['Resource group']=tostring(a.resourceGroup),
    Region=tostring(a.region),
    ['Scope read time']=todatetime(a.observedAt),
    ['Deployment ID']=deploymentId,
    ['Account ID']=tostring(a.hostId),
    ['Catalog source']=strcat('https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/', tostring(a.subscriptionId),
        '/providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/locations/', tostring(a.region), '/models?api-version=2024-10-01'),
    riskRank
| order by riskRank asc, ['Days remaining'] asc nulls last, ['Foundry / OpenAI account'] asc, Deployment asc, ['Deployment ID'] asc
| project-away riskRank
| extend _v2Row=row_number()
| where _v2Row > (toint('{V2PageIndex}') * 1000) and _v2Row <= ((toint('{V2PageIndex}') + 1) * 1000)
| project-away _v2Row
